model.why: MEASURED: the item carries vol. I of the 1816 print (printed pp. 1-425) — leaf 85 is the title page (“PROCLUS, THE PLATONIC SUCCESSOR, ON”), leaf 86 opens “2 ON THE THEOLOGY BOOK I”, leaf 509 carries “CHAP. XXXIX. OF PLATO. 425”, and the leaves after it are the digitizer’s end matter. The relation is the item’s own page-number pass as well as its own running heads: all 434 numbered leaves of _page_numbers.json carry printed page = leaf − 84, in one unbroken run from leaf 86 to leaf 516. So this copy’s archive leaf = printed page + 84 against this edition’s own offset of 73, i.e. its leaf = this edition’s leaf + 11.

model.why: MEASURED: the item is a second independent copy of vol. Its own page-number pass (_page_numbers.json, confidence 83.4) puts printed page = leaf − 77 on every one of its 430 numbered leaves, and the leaves’ own running heads agree — 72 of the 84 heads that carry a printed page give exactly that offset, the rest being digits the OCR mangled (“4C” for 46). So this copy’s archive leaf = printed page + 77, i.e. its leaf = this edition’s leaf + 4.

witnesses.name: proclus-theology-of-plato-taylor-vol-1-1816
witnesses.why: the transcription this edition SERVED until 2026-10-05 (vol. I): the item 'taylor-theology-of-plato-en-t.-1-1816' is an independent scan of the same 1816 print, and its text is the junk OCR the edition was re-sourced OFF. Held as a witness because it is an independent transcription of the same print, and because the 8,564 retired repair rules were derived against these bytes -- with its readings recorded here, a rule's evidence can still be re-checked. MEASURED over printed pp. 1-425: 85.5% of its tokens are dictionary words, against 97.6% for bub_gb_svwwAQAAMAAJ and 97.3% for the copy that is now the source, so where it disagrees with those two it is the copy that is wrong.

witnesses.name: proclus-theology-of-plato-taylor-vol-2-1816

An independent reading of the same pages this edition transcribes — not another OCR pass — so where this edition's transcription is damaged and PG reads the place cleanly, PG settles the READING (never the typography: it is re-flowed and editorially normalised, and it carries no page, line or leaf model).

form.no_model_block: THIS RECORD HAS NO `model` BLOCK, AND THAT IS THE MEASUREMENT. Every other witness here carries one: the leaf model of an archive.org item’s own _djvu.xml (covers/leaves/pages/images), which is what places a copy’s printed page beside ours. Project Gutenberg gives a RE-FLOWED READING TEXT — the line breaks are PG’s, the pages are not marked, and there is no leaf to point at — so it has no page model to record and none is invented. This witness is WORD-LEVEL ONLY: it can say whether a passage’s WORDS are in this volume and what they are there, and it can settle a reading by fingerprinting a token run that occurs exactly once (tools/pg-locate.mjs). It canNOT witness a printed page number, a running head, a leaf, a line, or a hyphenation at line end, and it cannot settle a page/leaf question (e.g. “chap. nr.” vs “CHAP. IV.”).
tools_that_skip_it_deliberately: tools/witness-unsure.mjs filters `witnesses` by `w.model` (the page-image route) — a witness with no leaf model has no page to fetch, so it is EXCLUDED there by name, not by accident.

tools/vision-unsure.mjs takes the FIRST witness in this file that has a file on disk as “the witness” for its corroboration test — so ORDER MATTERS, and these two are appended LAST: the witness that tool reads is unchanged by this import.

tools/vocab.mjs and tools/witness-unsure.mjs read EVERY witness’s text for the print’s own vocabulary, so these two volumes WIDEN that vocabulary (see the PROGRESS observation of 2026-10-07 in the handoff record for the measured size of the change).
tools/extract.mjs witnessPath() matches a witness by the SHELF filename a rule names — PG witnesses have none, so no existing rule’s evidence path changes.
tools/divisions.mjs reads a witness only where --witness FILE names one explicitly; it never reads this file.
tools/shelf.mjs and build/migrate.mjs read this record for its prose (name/why), not for a model.
